title: The desktop
body: The desktop BxCachy sets up Hyprland with Noctalia as the main desktop. KDE Plasma stays installed and gets tiling and a status panel; pick either (or both) at the login screen ( bxcachy session set hyprland|plasma ). Hyprland and Noctalia bxcachy setup hyprland installs the packages one by one and writes the starter configuration once. ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua is yours. BxCachy owns ~/.config/…

body: Shortcuts and Mac keys BxCachy keeps one shortcut table and renders it for xremap (Cmd-style keys, on both desktops), the Hyprland module and Plasma. title: The wizard program
body: The setup wizard The BxCachy setup wizard: a full-screen terminal form written in BoxLang on MatchBox's terminal canvas ( docs/tui.md in the MatchBox repo). It draws pages given as JSON and writes the answers as JSON. It runs nothing itself; bxcachy init starts it and acts on the answers (COMMAND-CONTRACT.md section 14). bxcachy wizard --pages=pages.json --out=answers.json [--answers=saved.json] b…

title: Security
body: Security Releases are signed. CI signs each channel's version-latest.properties and install.sh with an Ed25519 key. The public key is built into the program and into the published installer. The installer and bxcachy update verify the signature and the SHA-256 of every file they download; any mismatch stops before anything changes.
